summary: Fixes an E8 regression: Stage 30's createuser --pwprompt-over-stdin (r0036) is bypassed by real PostgreSQL, which prompts via /dev/tty when a terminal exists. Password is now set via a separate SQL step using psql's \getenv/:'var' quoting, never argv. Existing role from a partial failure resyncs its password when the target DB is empty/absent. Fake-createuser test replaced with real PostgreSQL + pty integration tests. No migration/dependency/package/service changes.
